title: No Inv Recipe Book(NIRB)
description: A Mod That Hides the recipe book in your inventory, though you still have it in workstations. Great for SMP Players
body:
# No Inventory Recipe Book (NIRB)

Have You Ever died in an SMP or nearly died because you forgot to close the recipe book before going into a fight? 

**Same for me.** 

This mod fixes that by simply removing the recipe book from your personal inventory, while keeping it completely normal inside crafting stations. 

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

### ✦ Features

» **No more having to remember to close the recipe book after crafting:** The recipe book is gone from your survival inventory, while still keeping the button for vanilla friendliness.

» **Crafting tables still work:** You can still use the recipe book exactly where it belongs (Crafting Tables, etc).

» **Clean GUI:** Unlike other mods that don't work or just make the inventory very ugly, NIRB keeps the vanilla look intact. 

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

### ✦ Why this mod?

When you are in a fight or exploring, the last thing you want is screen clutter. Most mods out there either delete the recipe book from *all* GUIs (which is annoying) or make your inventory UI look completely broken. 

>This Mod was Vibe Coded Using Deepseek AI.

**NIRB** is just a simple, straight-to-the-point fix for that!

**Jesus loves you!! He died for our sins, if you repent and believe in him you **will** be saved.**
